summary: This directory manages the execution environment metadata for the service. It provides centralized access to fundamental host information, including machine identification, networking details, and process tracking, ensuring that components have a consistent view of the current runtime state.
responsibilities: Identifying host machine and network characteristics
relationships: The Runtime Context acts as a container for Machine Identity and Process Metadata to provide a unified view of the service environment.
Network addresses are associated with the host machine to facilitate communication context within the runtime.
designDecisions: Centralized state management for environmental variables
Read-only access to immutable process and host identifiers
